findings.title: NPE on row whose email column is NULL (Optional.of instead of Optional.ofNullable)
findings.recommendation: Use Optional.ofNullable(rs.getString("email")) so a matched row with a NULL email column yields Optional.empty() instead of throwing NullPointerException. If NULL email is supposed to be an error, throw a domain-specific exception with a clear message rather than letting an NPE escape from a query method. Note the defect is reachable only when the users.email column is nullable (or a legacy row holds NULL); confirm the schema.
